reddit.title: Improved Music Transitions in Provincia
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to the music transitions in Provincia! No more abrupt cuts between day, night, title, and combat music. Our new long equal-power crossfade ensures a smoother listening experience. Check out the details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops

steam.title: Provincia Music System Update
steam.body: We're excited to announce an update to the music system in Provincia! The transitions between day, night, title, and combat music are now smoother with a long equal-power crossfade. This means a more immersive experience as you build your colony. Read more about the changes here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops
